data.name: Peyman
data.gender_notes: Peyman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Persian, Peyman means 'Reliable, Trustworthy, Protector'. This name is believed to bring strength and security to the one who bears it. The name Peyman carries the meaning “Reliable, Trustworthy, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Peyman usually hope their child will grow to embody reliable, trustworthy, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Peyman is a name with deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Amin', which means 'Trustworthy' and is a common name for boys in the Islamic world.
data.etymology: Peyman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reliable, Trustworthy, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Peyman total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: بيمان
in_arabic.meaning: بيمان يعني العهد أو الوعد أو الاتفاق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بيمان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ب ي م ن' والذي يعني الثبات والاستقرار. في اللغة العربية، بيمان هو العهد أو الوعد الذي يتم الاتفاق عليه بين الأفراد أو الجماعات. اسم بيمان يحمل معنى الالتزام والتعهد، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تعبر عن القيم الأخلاقية والاجتماعية الرفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: پییمان
in_urdu.meaning: پییمان کا مطلب ہے عہد یا وعد یا معاہدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: پییمان نام عربی جڑ 'ب ي م ن' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے استحکام اور استقرار۔ اردو میں، پییمان کا مطلب ہے وہ عہد یا وعد جو افراد یا گروہوں کے درمیان طے پایا ہو۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اعلیٰ اخلاقی اور سماجی اقدار کی عکاسی کرتا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے عہد کے پابند ہونا اور ذمہ داری کا احساس۔

in_hindi.name: पेयमान
in_hindi.meaning: पेयमान का अर्थ है वादा या प्रतिज्ञा या समझौता
in_hindi.long_meaning: पेयमान नाम अरबी मूल 'ब य म न' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है स्थिरता और स्थायित्व। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, पेयमान का नाम वादा या प्रतिज्ञा को दर्शाता है जो व्यक्तियों या समूहों के बीच किया जाता है। यह नाम उच्च नैतिक और सामाजिक मूल्यों को प्रतिबिंबित करता है, और इसका अर्थ है वचनबद्धता और जिम्मेदारी की भावना।

in_pashto.name: پییمان
in_pashto.meaning: پییمان د عہد یا وعد یا تړون معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: پییمان نوم د عربی ریښی 'ب ي م ن' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې دایمي او ثبات دی. په پښتو کې، پییمان د هغه عہد یا وعد څرګندونه کوي چې د کسانو یا ډلو تر منځ شوی دی. دا نوم د لوړو اخلاقي او ټولنیزو ارزښتونو څرګندونه کوي، او د ده دا معنی ده چې د ژمنې پابند او د مسؤلیت احساس.

in_english.name: Peyman
in_english.meaning: Peyman means covenant, promise, or agreement
in_english.long_meaning: The name Peyman originates from the Arabic root 'ب ي م ن' (b-y-m-n), which signifies stability and continuity. In Islamic tradition, Peyman refers to a covenant, promise, or agreement made between individuals or groups. This name embodies high moral and social values, connoting commitment, responsibility, and reliability. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the importance of pledges and bonds in Islamic society.

This name would be suitable for a person who is a pillar of support or a guardian in their community. It is valued and respected in Persian society as a testament to one's character and dependability.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Peyman signifies protection and shielding from harm. It is believed that the bearer of this name is strongly grounded in their faith and values, and they understand their role as a source of security and strength for others. Peyman is a name that resonates with the spiritual qualities of loyalty, faithfulness, and commitment, and those who carry it are thought to be deeply connected to their inner wisdom and the divine protection that it provides.
